name: Jina AI
label: Jina Reader / Search / DeepSearch / Embeddings
description: Official Jina Search Foundation HTTP: Reader POST https://r.jina.ai/ {url}, Search POST https://s.jina.ai/ {q}, DeepSearch POST https://deepsearch.jina.ai/v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compat, model jina-deepsearch-v1), Embeddings POST https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings. OfficialApiSpec has one baseUrl; embed overrides per-op. Bearer api_key. Reader fetches caller-supplied URLs only — honor robots.txt; not a paywall or robots bypass. Docs: https://jina.ai/reader/ · https://jina.ai/embeddings/ · https://jina.ai/deepsearch/.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. read requires url (http/https). search requires q. deep_research requires messages ([{role, content}] or user strings). embed requires embed_input (wire field input; string or string list). Agent tools: use embed_input or text — not top-level input (reserved). Example: {"url":"https://example.com/docs"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: read | search | deep_research | embed.

schema.label: url
schema.description: URL to read for read (r.jina.ai). Example: https://example.com.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for search (s.jina.ai). Example: studioquack workflow.

schema.label: site
schema.description: Restrict search to a site. Official site.

schema.label: gl
schema.description: Search country code. Official gl. Example: us.

schema.label: hl
schema.description: Search language. Official hl. Example: en.

schema.label: num
schema.description: Search result count. Official num.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Chat messages [{role, content}] for deep_research. Official messages.

schema.label: model
schema.description: Model id for deep_research / embed. Example: jina-embeddings-v3.

schema.label: embed_input
schema.description: Text or list of texts for embed (maps to API input). Tools: embed_input or text.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Alias for embed_input on operation embed.

schema.label: task
schema.description: embed task. Typical: retrieval.query | retrieval.passage | text-matching | classification.

schema.label: dimensions
schema.description: embed dimensions.

schema.label: embedding_type
schema.description: embed embedding_type. Typical: float | base64 | binary.

schema.label: normalized
schema.description: embed normalized.

schema.label: late_chunking
schema.description: embed late_chunking.

schema.label: truncate
schema.description: embed truncate.

schema.label: reasoning_effort
schema.description: deep_research reasoning_effort. Typical: low | medium | high.

schema.label: location
schema.description: Search location bias. Official location.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Search page. Official page.

schema.label: budget_tokens
schema.description: deep_research budget_tokens.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (JSON or markdown wrapped by OfficialApiNode). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (title/url/content, search results, chat completion, or embeddings data[]).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb. EXACT: read | search | deep_research | embed.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Jina API key (https://jina.ai/?sui=apikey). Authorization: Bearer. Required for search, DeepSearch, and embeddings; strongly recommended for Reader (anonymous Reader is a tight RPM pool). Never on INPUT. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 60 (Reader/DeepSearch are slow). Floor 1. DeepSearch can exceed 60s on hard questions — raise if needed.
